howItWorks.title: Evidence-First Verification Pipeline
howItWorks.subtitle: We don't just tell you something looks risky. We show you exactly why.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Paste suspicious text, upload a screenshot, or enter a URL securely.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Extract evidence, analyze regex rules, NLP patterns, and safety indicators.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Understand what triggered each warning and why it represents an investor hazard.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Cross-reference claims with official SEBI registration registries.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Execute a structured safety action plan before any financial transfer.

scanners.textSubtitle: Paste the investment message exactly as you received it from WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, or social media.
